column1: At Amazon, we believe in the power of computer science
to unleash creativity and unlock human potential. We
also know that while talent and passion are spread across
all young people, opportunity is not. We are dedicated
to inspiring future builders, especially those from
underrepresented and underserved communities. As part
of our community focus, we work to increase access to
high-quality computer science education.

Amazon Future Engineer is Amazon’s signature computer
science education program designed to inspire and educate
millions of students from underserved communities across
the globe, including hundreds of thousands of students
in the U.S. each year. Students explore computer science
through school curriculum and project-based learning
using code to make music, program robots, and solve
problems. Amazon Future Engineer also awards 100
students each year with four-year, $40,000 scholarships
and paid internships at Amazon, and celebrates teachers
